mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (correlation coefficient p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous three months signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp does not correlate with positive returns (correlation coefficient p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous six months signals strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increase does not correlate with positive returns (correlation coefficient p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals increased economic activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with positive returns (correlation coefficient p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS > 4.5% does not correlate with negative returns (correlation coefficient p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decrease by more than 5% over the previous two months, it signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decrease > 5% does not correlate with negative returns (correlation coefficient p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strong labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k & UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with positive returns (correlation coefficient p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized over the previous month, it signals an accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure
